ألتظي (form VIII)
# أَلْتَظِي (ʔaltaẓī) /ʔal.ta.ðˤiː/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِلْتَظَى (iltaẓā)
# أَلْتَظِيَ (ʔaltaẓiya) /ʔal.ta.ðˤi.ja/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِلْتَظَى (iltaẓā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
